verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is API-first. It documents a public Payments API v3 for payments and payouts, plus Data and Verification APIs. Supporting docs cover bearer-token plus ECDSA request signing, official SDKs in Node.js, Python, Java and .NET, open-source signing libraries on GitHub, a sandbox quickstart, programmatic webhooks, and an llms.txt with markdown versions of every docs page. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec found (all probe paths returned 404), no independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
